origin.selectionPolicy: threshold and horizon selected on discovery only, then direction checked unchanged on validation and holdout

frozenRule.outcome: at least one winning Lightning event in the next 7 chronological rounds

prospectiveEpisodeProtocol.trigger: when no episode is active and the completed-round state has gap >= 8, open one prediction for the following 7 rounds
prospectiveEpisodeProtocol.close: success immediately at first winning Lightning event; otherwise failure after 7 completed future rounds

immutability: Do not change threshold, horizon, trigger, outcome, comparator or gates. Any change creates v2 and restarts prospectivo.
